subject: Recap: Redwood demo + procurement / billing next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acmehealth.com>, Daniel Park <daniel.park@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, Feb 10, 2026 at 3:12 PM PST
Subject: Recap: Redwood demo + procurement / billing next steps

Hi Samantha / Daniel —

Thanks again for taking the time today — appreciated the thoughtful questions. Quick recap and proposed next steps so procurement has what you need to move forward: 

1) Pilot & scope: 3 seats (chat generation + embeddings), 30-day pilot starting after contract signature.
2) Pricing & billing: demo pricing shared during call (pilot rate $X/month); final pricing will be in SOW.
3) Procurement questions we discussed: PO vs card for pilot, net terms, invoice format, tax/VAT fields, billing address, and marketplace option (AWS Marketplace).

Attachments: I’m including your PO template and our standard TOS for review (Acme_PO_Template.docx; Redwood_TOS_v3.pdf).

Immediate asks for procurement to unblock us:
- Confirm whether you will issue a PO for the pilot or process via corporate card.
- If PO: please confirm the billing contact name, billing address, and whether Acme requires a specific invoice line item format or VAT ID on the invoice.
- If you prefer AWS Marketplace subscription, flag that here and we’ll provide marketplace seller info (note: marketplace procurement can add 1–2 weeks to provisioning).

Next steps from our side:
- I’ll loop in Rishi (finance) and Laura (CS) to confirm invoicing details and whether we can accommodate your requested net terms.
- If you can return the PO template filled and any procurement form, we’ll draft the SOW + MSA and route for signature.

Thanks — I’m around all week if you want to jump back on a quick call to walk procurement through the flow.

Best,
Marissa
Marissa Cole | Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0198

Cc: Daniel Park <daniel.park@acmehealth.com>, procurement@acmehealth.com
Date: Wed, Feb 11, 2026 at 09:08 AM PST
Subject: Re: Recap: Redwood demo + procurement / billing next steps

Thanks Marissa — great demo. A few quick procurement questions so we can get finance moving: 

- Acme prefers to issue a PO for vendor relationships. For pilot, we can do a PO but need invoices to include: PO number, line item descriptions, and Acme’s billing address. I attached our standard procurement form for you to review (Acme_Procurement_Form.pdf).
- Net terms: finance typically requires net 45 for new vendors; is Redwoods able to accommodate net 45?
- Tax/VAT: we’re US-headquartered (no VAT), but we will need Redwood’s tax ID and W-9 on file. For European subsidiaries there may be VAT implications later — can you supply VAT registration or confirm if invoices can include VAT ID fields when needed?
- Marketplace: we prefer buying through AWS Marketplace where possible. Do you publish as a seller there or will procurement need a direct invoice from Redwood?

If you can confirm those items and send vendor paperwork (W-9, tax id, vendor name/address) we’ll get the PO in flight.

Thanks,
Samantha Lee
Head of Procurement
Acme Health
Samantha.Lee@acmehealth.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acmehealth.com>, Daniel Park <daniel.park@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, Feb 12, 2026 at 11:27 AM PST
Subject: Re: Recap: Redwood demo + procurement / billing next steps

Hi Samantha —

Appreciate the clarity — answers below. I’ll also attach the docs you requested in a follow-up email.

- PO vs card: we can accept a PO for the pilot and ongoing contract. For a short pilot, we can also accept a corporate card if that speeds things up (no procurement paperwork required).
- Net terms: our standard is net 30, but for enterprise customers we can approve net 45 on a case-by-case basis. I’ve looped Rishi (finance) here to confirm; he indicated we can accommodate net 45 for this deal.
- Invoice format & fields: we can include PO number, line item descriptions, billing/contact info, and a field for VAT ID when required. Please confirm the exact billing address and the billing contact (name + email) you want on invoices.
- Tax & W-9: Redwood’s tax ID (EIN) is 12-3456789; we can provide a completed W-9 and our vendor onboarding packet.
- Marketplace: Redwood is available on AWS Marketplace for SaaS subscriptions. If Acme prefers to procure via AWS Marketplace, that’s supported — note that invoice flow goes through AWS and can delay provisioning by ~1 week. If you need a direct invoice from Redwood instead, we can do that and it will go to the billing contact you provide.

Next steps: please send the PO (or confirm you’ll pay by card), confirm billing address and contact, and we’ll produce the SOW + MSA and send via DocuSign. If convenient, I can also set a 15-min call with our procurement/finance lead to walk through any specific fields.

Thanks — I’ll attach our W-9 and vendor packet in a separate email so procurement has everything.

Best,
Marissa
